newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Chang Hwa cuts prime rate.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Chang Hwa cuts prime rate.

text.p: Chang Hwa Commercial Bank on Wednesday became the third of Taiwan's Big Three state-run banks to cut its prime lending rate, trimming the rate to 7.55 percent from 7.60, effective on Thursday.
The bank said it also would cut most of its time deposit rates by 0.05 to 0.15 percentage points.
Fellow Big Three members First Commercial Bank and Hua Nan Commercial Bank said on Tuesday they were were cutting their prime rates by 0.05 percentage points to 7.55.
